nodes.label: Wave Confinement Theory
nodes.description: The mathematical and computational research program from which the listed implementation directions are explored.

nodes.label: Photonics
nodes.description: Optical and resonant experiments investigate persistence, harmonic structure, perturbation, and relocking behavior.

nodes.label: Persistent wave memory
nodes.description: A filed memory architecture explores addressable information states encoded in bounded persistent wave-interference configurations.

nodes.label: WaveLock
nodes.description: WaveLock explores nonlinear PDE evolution, path-dependent commitments, replay-verifiable records, and runtime drift detection.

nodes.label: AI / RCA
nodes.description: RCA applies bounded resonance and coherence concepts to intelligent-system architecture, recursive drift, and correction limits.

nodes.label: Secure computation
nodes.description: The program explores physically constrained commitments and one-way behavior; production cryptographic security remains an explicit open validation target.

nodes.label: Control systems
nodes.description: Feedback, bounded-state regulation, diagnostics, and relocking motivate control-oriented applications without collapsing engineering performance into theory status.

nodes.label: Scientific instrumentation
nodes.description: Photodiode, spectroscopy, cavity, and public-data workflows provide instrumentation and measurement paths for testing narrower claims.
